# ONARIKA

ONARIKA is an independent limited-edition streetwear label. Its current public catalog contains three physical FIRST CONTACT apparel artifacts: Shadow Oracle Field Unit, Signal 14 Field Unit, and Cosmic Oracle Field Unit.

- Canonical website: https://onarika.net/
- Official marketplace: https://www.etsy.com/shop/Onarika
- Products are physical apparel, not digital downloads.
- Current products are made to order and fulfilled through Printify after confirmed Etsy checkout.
- Support: support@onarika.net
